name: Crusader's Mantle

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry.

targets.description: you and your allies while in the aura

summary: 30-foot aura: you and allies in it deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage on weapon and Unarmed Strike hits.
text: You radiate a 30-foot Emanation until the spell ends. While inside it, you and each of your allies deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage whenever you hit with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.
